mapper.select: select p.id, p.shop_code, p.package_code, p.package_name, p.is_active, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_user, p.update_time, (select count(1) from sdsorder.u_o_package_item i where i.shop_code = p.shop_code and i.package_code = p.package_code) goods_kinds from sdsorder.u_o_package p where p.shop_code = #{shopCode} and p.package_code like concat('%',#{packageCode},'%') and p.package_name like concat('%',#{packageName},'%') and p.is_active = #{isActive} order by p.is_active desc, p.package_code

select p.id, p.shop_code, p.package_code, p.package_name, p.is_active, p.remark, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_user, p.update_time, (select count(1) from sdsorder.u_o_package_item i where i.shop_code = p.shop_code and i.package_code = p.package_code) goods_kinds from sdsorder.u_o_package p where p.shop_code = #{shopCode} and p.package_code = #{packageCode}
